verdict.rationale: Discord provides developer building blocks (Gateway events, webhooks, bots, slash commands) that a third-party developer could use to build automation, but there is no evidence of a native, user-facing rule-builder (e.g., 'when X happens, do Y' automation/workflow feature) that an end user can define without writing bot code. This story asks for built-in AI-native automation/trigger rules, which Discord does not natively expose to non-developer users. missing for 10: a native no-code automation/rules engine, evidence of AI-native trigger-action configuration, first-party workflow/automation UI.
